args.prompt: Evening, a lived-in bedroom vanity of worn dark walnut: the exact VESPER perfume bottle from the reference image (heavy rectangular thick clear-glass bottle with bevelled edges, amber-gold juice, tall faceted smoky-amber cap with thin gold collar, VESPER engraved in thin wide-spaced serif capitals) is the source of truth for the product; it stands among a gold ring, a folded burgundy silk scarf and an open book, a blurred brass lamp edge in the left foreground; venetian-blind shadows fall across the wood. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35, 50mm Cooke S4 prime at T2.8, Kodak Vision3 500T film grain, subtle halation. Single hard 3200K tungsten key through a narrow snoot from camera-left, raking across the glass and falling off fast into deep shadow; faint cool 5600K window spill from behind. Off-centre composition, product on the right third, three-quarter angle. Real-world imperfections: faint fingerprints and a few dust specks on the glass, a tiny scuff on the cap collar. No HDR, no oversaturation, no digital sharpening, no CG gloss, no perfect symmetry, no beauty grade. This is a film frame, not an advertisement.
